topic: 据点帕鲁吃几口就走又很快回来
zh: 据点帕鲁饿了会到饲料箱吃东西，吃到足以解除饥饿就可能回去工作。若吃的是低营养食物，一口只补少量饱食度，很快又会饿，于是反复往返。试着把饲料箱里优先供给的红色野莓（营养 15）换成沙拉（84）或果酱面包（51）。这个行为解释来自玩家观察，资料没有确认所有帕鲁都按同一对百分比开始或停止进食。
en: Hungry base workers go to the Feed Box. Players report that a worker resumes its job after eating enough to leave the hungry state. A low-nutrition serving may barely get it over that threshold, so it gets hungry again soon. Try replacing the berries you serve (15 nutrition) with salad (84) or jam-filled buns (51). The reports do not establish a universal pair of start and stop percentages.

zh: 如果是玩家放置的储物箱，有玩家转述私锁提示说，实际放置箱子的人仍可拆除。若还能打开，可先取走物品，再请建造者本人在建造菜单进入拆除模式，对准这只箱子操作。案例中升为会长也没有解决私锁。如果建造者仍看到红色私锁提示，请核对箱子的实际放置者及服务器权限，再请管理员检查。
en: For a player-built storage chest, a player report of the private-lock prompt says its original builder can still dismantle it. Have the player who placed it use the build menu's dismantle mode on that chest, after emptying it if possible. In the reported case a guild promotion did not restore access. If the builder still sees the private-lock warning, verify the owner and server permissions with the administrator.

topic: 私人储物箱的访问权限
zh: 消耗品图鉴中的钥匙用于岛上刷新的上锁宝箱。对于玩家建造的私锁储物箱，记录能确认的是建造者仍可尝试拆除，个案中升为公会会长也没有恢复访问。若想保留箱子、只取出物品，请让放置它的玩家先检查箱子设置和当前成员的访问权限。随包资料没有记载可用哪把宝箱钥匙打开这种箱子。
en: The consumables record covers keys for locked treasure chests that spawn in the world. For a player-built private storage chest, a reported in-game prompt says the builder can dismantle it. A guild promotion did not restore access in that case. To keep the chest and retrieve its contents, ask its builder to check the storage settings and member access. The records do not identify a treasure key for this player-built container.

topic: 配种筛选子代的普通被动
zh: 可以培育出不带这类普通固定词条的子代。配种时，子代从亲本的被动中抽取词条，也可能随机产生新被动。可以选没有目标词条的亲本来配出想要的物种，再留下未继承该词条的子代继续繁育。每颗蛋的结果要孵化后确认。这种筛选影响后代，亲本已有的词条会保留。
en: You can breed offspring without an ordinary species-fixed passive. A child can inherit a selection of its parents' passives and may roll additional ones. Pick parents without the unwanted trait that can produce your target species, then hatch and keep a child without that passive for further breeding. This selection affects the offspring. The parent's existing traits stay with that individual.

zh: 没有一只帕鲁是所有配种路线都要经过的。可以先在配种表里反查目标子代。比如阿努比斯有多组亲本；空涡龙的记录只有一只公空涡龙与一只母空涡龙。传词条时，从实际带词条的亲本出发，每一代留能接上下一组、且确实继承了词条的子代。给出目标物种和现有亲本后，就能缩小到能走通的路线。
en: There is no required intermediate Pal for every breeding route. Start by looking up the desired offspring's parent combinations. Anubis has many pairs, while Jetragon's recorded pair is a male and a female Jetragon. To transfer a passive, start with an actual carrier and keep an offspring that inherited it and can mate with the next parent. The target species and the parents you have determine the workable route.

zh: 普通世界的岛屿地形和固定矿点有共用坐标，换存档也能按同一张地图找矿。采走的矿石要等矿点刷新。世界设置里的随机模式改变野生帕鲁的分布，可以产生不同的野怪组合。
en: The standard world uses the same island terrain and fixed resource-node locations across saves. A depleted node has to respawn. The world's random Pal mode can change which wild Pals appear in an area.

zh: 同种、同级的两只帕鲁也会有不同的生命、攻击和防御。三项各有一个 0–100 的个体值，数值越高，相应属性的成长越好。装备伯乐眼镜可以直接查看这三项，挑亲本时也能据此比较。
en: IVs are the individual potential for a Pal's HP, Attack and Defense. Each has its own score from 0 to 100. A higher score gives more of that stat at the same species and level. Equip Ability Glasses to inspect all three when choosing a Pal or a parent.

zh: 从 1.0 起，身处据点范围内就可以打开大地图，直接选择其他据点或已激活的巨鹫之像，无须走回帕鲁终端。在野外也可从已激活的巨鹫之像出发。帕鲁终端控制台用来远程管理据点帕鲁，不会增加一个地图传送目的地。
en: Since 1.0, open the map anywhere inside your base and select another base or an activated Great Eagle Statue. You do not have to walk to the Palbox. In the field you can also depart from an activated statue. The Palbox Control Device is for remote management and does not add another travel destination.

zh: 作为服主，停止服务器，打开该服务器正在使用的 PalWorldSettings.ini，在 OptionSettings 中填写 ServerPassword 的值，保存并重启。玩家加入时输入这个密码。
en: Stop your dedicated server and open its active PalWorldSettings.ini. Set ServerPassword in OptionSettings, save it, and restart the server. Players enter that password when joining.

zh: 在来源世界先把帕鲁登记到跨界帕鲁终端，然后在目标世界的跨界终端选择已登记的帕鲁。专服由服主检查来源世界的 bAllowGlobalPalboxExport 和目标世界的 bAllowGlobalPalboxImport 是否允许对应方向；修改配置后重启对应服务器。
en: Register the Pal in the source world's Global Palbox, then select its record at a Global Palbox in the destination world. On dedicated servers, the host should check bAllowGlobalPalboxExport on the source and bAllowGlobalPalboxImport on the destination. Restart any server whose configuration changed.

zh: 据点里出现的旅行商人属于来访事件。建好据点后留意来客提示，游戏没有给这个商人一个可保证的来访操作或倒计时。想马上交易，可传送到小型聚落，直接找固定商人；不同商人出售的物品不同。
en: A wandering merchant arriving at your base is a visitor event. Watch for the arrival message after establishing the base. There is no guaranteed action or countdown for a particular merchant to visit. To trade now, go to the fixed merchant at the Small Settlement and check their stock.

zh: 你遇到的是据点来了商人的提示，还是路上碰到商人和护卫？如果是据点来访，可以趁对方停留时交谈交易；如果想找固定货源，可以从小型聚落的商店查起。
en: Was this a visitor arriving at your base, or a merchant encounter out on the road? For a visitor, speak to them while they're at the base to trade. For a fixed shop, try the merchant at the Small Settlement. Tell me which encounter or item you're looking for.

zh: 找帕鲁商人打开出售帕鲁界面，依次点选要卖的个体，核对选中列表后一起确认。一次交易可以卖多只，同一物种的不同个体仍需要分别选中。
en: At a Pal Merchant choose the option to sell Pals. Mark each individual you intend to sell, review the selection and confirm the transaction together. Selling several in one transaction still involves selecting each Pal individually.

zh: 繁殖孵出的头目个体也能在屠宰时掷本物种的头目掉落表。先确认目标图纸列在该物种的头目掉落里，再核对个体确有头目标记。产自配种牧场不影响这次判定，结果仍是随机，屠宰也会消耗该个体。
en: A bred and hatched Alpha can roll its species' Alpha loot when butchered. Check that the specific schematic appears in that species' Alpha drops and that the individual actually has the Alpha mark. Bred origin does not disqualify it. The roll can miss and butchering consumes the Pal.

zh: 常规野外头目（例如灼热矿道里的灼焰牛）随游戏内新的一天重新出现。回到它的固定点检查；昼夜速度设置会改变实际要等的分钟数。如果打的是封印领域里的头目，请看领域入口显示的重试计时。
en: For an overworld Alpha such as Blazamut in the Scorching Mineshaft, check its fixed spot again after the in-game day turns over. Day and night speed affect the wait in real minutes. A Sealed Realm boss is a different encounter with a retry timer shown at the entrance.

zh: 八云犬的伙伴技能只会提高野捕时出现合格被动的机会。不死之身等突变被动被排除，八云犬即使带着该词条也无法在捕捉时复制它。可用已有该突变的亲本尝试配种遗传，或在手术台消耗对应的植入体。
en: Yakumo's Birds of a Feather increases the chance of eligible passives on capture. Mutation passives such as Immortality are excluded even if Yakumo has the trait. A parent with the mutation can pass it to offspring through breeding, or you can use the matching disposable implant at a Surgery Table.

zh: 先看地图上的野外蛋点，再查该区域的蛋池。地点、蛋的属性和大小共同限定可孵出的物种；在两个地区捡到外观相同的蛋，候选也可能不同。比如要从大型暗黑帕鲁蛋孵出墨罗娜，可去世界树有对应蛋池的区域找，捡到一个大型暗黑蛋并不保证是它。
en: Look for wild egg points in the region whose egg pool contains the species. Region, egg type and size all matter; two identical-looking eggs from different regions can have different candidates. For example, Solenne is in a Large Dark Egg pool on the World Tree, alongside other possible hatches.

zh: 可以保留高级设施。塞赫麦特会加快自己在工作台和作业工厂的工作，可以负责手工阶段。遇到同时列出手工作业和制药的古代文明工作台，再分配一只制药适性达到要求的帕鲁完成对应工作。观察哪个工序在等人，再决定是否用另一条生产线分流。
en: You can keep higher-tier facilities. Sekhmet gets an efficiency bonus while working at workbenches and assembly lines and can cover handiwork. At an Ancient Workbench requiring both handiwork and medicine production, assign a second Pal with the required medicine suitability. Check which task is waiting before adding another line.

zh: 先在岸边备好能回程的水上坐骑、弹药、护盾和回复品，从水面接近平台可避开针对飞行坐骑的防空激光。上平台后先找掩体，逐段清敌并留好撤回水面的路线。挑战顶级平台争夺大箱时还要为武装直升机预留弹药和掩体。
en: Prepare a swimming mount, ammo, a shield and healing items on shore. Approach at water level to avoid the anti-air lasers that target flying mounts. Once aboard, clear enemies from cover and keep a route back to the water. On the high-level rig, save ammo and cover for the attack chopper guarding the big chest.

zh: 普通塔首通的古代科技点和困难重赛的奖励是两项。困难塔不会再发普通或古代科技点，刷科技点应改找科技手册等来源。困难塔有对应首领头饰等通关奖励。
en: The Ancient Technology Points from a normal tower's first clear are separate from Hard Mode rematch rewards. The Hard rematch gives zero regular or Ancient Technology Points; use technology manuals if points are the goal. Hard clears have other rewards such as the tower boss's headwear.

zh: 把翠叶鼠雕像交给力量石像，购买玩家捕获力升级后才生效。1.0 的第一级只花 1 个。由零起算，1–15 级的累计消耗依次是 1、3、6、10、15、21、28、37、46、55、64、73、82、91、100，具体成功率还取决于球和目标。
en: Offer Lifmunk Effigies at a Statue of Power and buy the player capture-power upgrade. Rank 1 already works and costs one effigy. In 1.0 the cumulative costs from rank zero through ranks 1–15 are 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21, 28, 37, 46, 55, 64, 73, 82, 91 and 100. Actual catch chance also depends on the sphere and target.

zh: 采矿、伐木和把产物搬回箱子是不同工种。在据点安排有搬运适性的帕鲁，在监控台允许它搬运，并检查它是否固定在其他岗位。把有空位、允许接收该产物的储物箱放到设施旁，确认两端都能走到，再观察已完成的产物有没有被搬走。
en: Mining, logging, and hauling their output are different jobs. Give a base Pal with Transporting permission to haul at the Monitoring Stand and check that it is not fixed to another job. Place a chest with free space that accepts the material next to the facility. Check the route to both ends and see whether the finished output is picked up.

zh: 如果要重分配玩家升级时加的属性点，可以让玩家服用消除记忆药，然后重新加点。物品说明明确写了帕鲁服用无效。
en: If you mean the player’s allocated stat points, the player can take Memory Wiping Medicine, then allocate those points again. Its item description says it has no effect when given to a Pal.

zh: 在监控台选择具体的据点帕鲁，关闭不希望它做的工种，保留它有适性的工作。如果有两个设施都需要同一种适性，工种开关无法区分它们，可以将工人固定分配到目标工位，并确认它能走到那里。
en: At the Monitoring Stand, select the base worker and disable the jobs you do not want it doing. Leave a job it has the suitability for enabled. If two facilities use the same suitability, the job toggle applies to both. Assign the worker to the desired workstation and check that it can reach it.

zh: 先看世界是否仍在运行。玩家曾观察到，离开一处据点后部分作业仍有进度，不同设施和野外资源的实际产出可能不同。单机退出世界和离开据点是两种情况，专服在客户端退出后仍可运行。若想查自己的生产线，在两个据点各记一笔相同工单和库存，过相同游戏时间再比较。本版资料没有可套用到所有工种的远程效率比例。
en: First check whether the world is still running. Players have observed some work progressing at distant bases, with different results for facilities and natural resource nodes. Leaving the base differs from closing a solo world. A dedicated server can stay running when the client closes. To check a particular job, record matching orders and inventories at two bases over the same interval. The available records do not give a universal remote production rate.

zh: 据玩家对防御属性的记录，提高玩家防御后，护盾承受同一类可减免攻击时也会少扣一些；盾耗尽后，防御仍能减轻生命受到的伤害。这里说的是一次命中造成的损失，护盾容量和充能是另外的属性。这条社区记录早于1.0，现有资料未给出当前版本的精确减伤公式。
en: According to a player report, defense mitigates eligible incoming hits while the shield is active and continues to protect health after it runs out. This concerns how much a hit takes away. Shield capacity and recharge are separate properties. The report predates 1.0 and does not establish an exact formula for the current build.

zh: 如果挪的是已放下的普通设施或家具，先取走箱里物资或工位产物，在建造菜单进入拆除模式，只拆这个物件，再在新位置建起来。如果要搬的是箱子里的物资，可以先收到背包，再存入目标箱。你要挪的是哪个物件？
en: For a placed piece of furniture or ordinary workstation, empty its storage or collect its output, select just that object in the build menu’s Disassembly Mode, then rebuild it at the new spot. For supplies inside a chest, transfer them into inventory and put them in the destination chest. Which object are you moving?

zh: 可以逐步解锁。升级送的点数用完后，仍能反复取得并使用技术书来补普通科技点。例如高等技术书可以从暗巫猫等帕鲁的掉落取得。古代科技点是另一种点数，古代技术书可以补充。若某项有等级或其他前置条件，光有点数仍不能跳过它。
en: You can keep working toward all unlocks after spending your level-up points. Repeatable drops such as the Advanced Technical Manual from Katress give ordinary Technology Points. Ancient Technology Points are separate and can be obtained from Ancient Technical Manuals. Having points does not bypass a technology's level or other prerequisites.

zh: 在同一据点给配种牧场各分配一只可配种的异性帕鲁，确认牧场界面能识别双亲。把蛋糕放进牧场自带的箱子，并腾出产蛋区。若有一只总是离开，检查它能否走到牧场、是否失去工作能力，再用监控台重新固定分配。
en: Assign two breedable Pals of opposite sex to the same Breeding Farm and check that the farm recognizes both parents. Put cake in the farm's own chest and clear space for eggs. If a parent leaves, check its path and condition and reassign it at the Monitoring Stand.
